# The Garage Flip

> White-glove garage cleanout and organization in Orlando, Florida. Every quote is fixed in writing before work begins. Same-week scheduling across Orlando and Orange County.

The Garage Flip is a small, hands-on studio that clears, sorts, hauls, and organizes garages — treating the most neglected room in the home to estate-grade care. Two core services: The Reset (full cleanout, from $600) and The Refresh (cleanout plus organization with wall systems, overhead racks, and labeled bins, from $1,200). Contact: (407) 735-6450 · hello@thegarageflip.com.

## Core pages
- [Home](https://thegarageflip.com/): Overview of cleanout and organization services in Orlando.
- [Pricing](https://thegarageflip.com/pricing): The Reset, The Refresh, and The Retreat — fixed pricing by garage size, in writing before we begin.
- [For Realtors](https://thegarageflip.com/realtors): Listing-ready garage cleanouts with same-week turnaround and documented before-and-afters.
- [Estate & Transitions](https://thegarageflip.com/estate-cleanouts-orlando): Compassionate estate and downsizing garage clear-outs.

## Guides
- [How much does a garage cleanout cost in Orlando?](https://thegarageflip.com/garage-cleanout-cost-orlando): Real price ranges ($600–$1,800), what drives the number, and why fixed written quotes beat hourly billing.
- [Garage cleanout vs. junk removal](https://thegarageflip.com/garage-cleanout-vs-junk-removal): Junk removal hauls what you've already sorted; a cleanout does the sorting too. How to tell which you need.
- [How to prepare for an estate garage cleanout](https://thegarageflip.com/how-to-prepare-estate-garage-cleanout): What to look for first, what to set aside, involving family, and handling it from out of state.
